note: Dense NN (Normalization -> Dense64 -> Dense32 -> ratio head, baked multiply-back-by-today's-price) trained on an Agmarknet historical price mirror (khandelwalmanas/daily-commodity-prices-india on Kaggle), aggregated to a daily national median per commodity, 2015-2025. On held-out data this ties the naive 'price stays the same' baseline on every commodity (~3% MAPE either way) -- month-of-year + commodity identity alone don't carry enough signal at a 7-day horizon without a recent-price-momentum feature, which would require caching local price history the app doesn't keep. Ship the point forecast alongside volatility_bands.json (empirical p10/p90 ratio bands per commodity per day-ahead, from the same historical data) so the UI shows an honest range, not false precision. See docs/MODEL_SPECS.md section 3.
outputDescription: Absolute predicted price (same units as today_price) for each of the next 7 days.
